project_type: Python/FastAPI backend + Vue 3 frontend audit platform
build_system: pip (backend, venv at .venv); npm (frontend at audit-platform/frontend/)
build_command: N/A (no separate compile step; backend is pure Python, frontend uses Vite dev server)
test_command: Backend: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend/tests/<path> -v --tb=short (from repo root); Frontend: npx vitest run <path> --reporter=verbose (from audit-platform/frontend/)
verification_instructions: 1. Run relevant backend pytest tests from repo root with .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend/tests/<file> -v --tb=short; 2. Run frontend vitest from audit-platform/frontend/ with npx vitest run <path> --reporter=verbose; 3. Use ';' not '&&' to chain commands on Windows
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell; python not python3; use ';' not '&&' for chaining; cwd param for directory-specific commands; rtk prefix for git/pytest/vitest output compression; pre-commit hooks enforce file size limits; GtWpRenderer.vue is large (>1200 lines) — read before editing
contribution_requirements: Services only flush, routers commit; UI all-Chinese (keep technical terms English); S-class does NOT write back trial_balance; match_workpapers is pure function with no DB/IO; wp_code_overrides.json has mtime hot-reload; new componentTypes must be added to VALID_COMPONENT_TYPES set in wp_classification_service.py AND htmlRendererRegistry.ts type union AND specialized.ts entries
key_patterns: resolveProcedureSheetKey uses startsWith if-chain with long-prefix-first ordering (e.g., G14 before G1); wp_code_overrides.json uses {parent_wp_code}-{sheet_tab_name} keys for per-sheet routing (see D0-* confirmation pattern); specialized.ts entries use defineAsyncComponent with standard shape {componentType, component, icon, label, emits, contextProps}; backend applicable_when data lives in wp_account_mapping.json under each mapping entry
directory_structure: backend/app/services/ — business logic; backend/app/routers/ — FastAPI endpoints; backend/app/data/ — runtime JSON data files (wp_code_overrides.json); backend/data/ — static data (wp_account_mapping.json); backend/wp_templates/S/ — S-cycle Excel templates; audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/ — Vue workpaper components; audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/s-checklist/ — 12 orphan S sub-sheet components; audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/registry/entries/ — htmlRendererRegistry entries; audit-platform/frontend/src/utils/ — utility functions including resolveProcedureSheetKey; audit-platform/frontend/src/composables/ — Vue composables
